form.heading: Signature
form.hint: Enter your full name and your title at the company, then sign in the box.
form.name: Full name
form.title: Title at the company
form.trailNote: Signing records your name, your title, the date, your IP address and the exact version of this document (SHA-256 fingerprint):
signed.title: Document signed
signed.body: Done. The contractor has your signature; there is nothing else you need to do.
declined.title: Document not signed
declined.body: We recorded that you did not sign this document. Contact the contractor if you would like to review it.
gone.title: This link is no longer active
gone.body: The link was already used, expired, or the contractor withdrew it. Ask them for a new one.
invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.body: We couldn't open this link. Check that you copied all of it, or ask for a new one.
errors.submit: The signature could not be recorded. Please try again.
errors.decline: Your response could not be recorded. Please try again.
panel.title: Customer signature
panel.none: No signature has been requested for this document yet.
panel.notSent: No email: copy the link and send it yourself
panel.emailHint: Leave it empty to skip the email: the link is generated for you to copy.
panel.error: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
panel.documentChanged: Heads up: this invoice changed after the link went out.
panel.documentChangedHint: The client sees and signs the version that was sent. To have them sign the new one, request the signature again.
